description: This file defines a React functional component 'CompoundPredicateBuilder' used for building compound predicates with logical operators ('and'/'or') in a user interface. It handles rendering of predicate conditions, selection options for keypaths and operators, and manages predicate addition/removal.

methods.name: CompoundPredicateBuilder
methods.description: React functional component that renders UI for building logical compound predicates with conditions, handling user interactions like adding, removing, and changing predicates.
